capabilities: Show a tooltip with the URL when hovering an external link
Skip previews for links whose text already equals the URL
Adjust tooltip background and text color via CSS variables
extras: Installation from within Obsidian is listed as 'Coming Soon'; currently only manual installation from a release is documented. Works only in preview (reading) mode, not editing mode.
problem: In preview mode, external links whose text differs from their URL hide the actual destination, so you cannot see where a link points without opening it.
summary: Hover plugin that shows a tooltip with the destination URL when hovering external links in rendered Markdown preview.
